identity.question: does the MOUTH's motion, measured with a face landmark model, track the AUDIO's speech in time?
identity.fps_evidence: 900 frames = 30.00 s at 30 fps against a 29.981 s recording (36.0 s at 25 fps); the empty room is 4500 frames = 150.00 s at 30 fps against 149.906 s (180 s at 25 fps). The frame rate is DERIVED from the two spans agreeing, not assumed. Read at the repository's 23040-byte stride the video would be 25 s for 30 s of audio, which is the same disagreement seen from the other side.

record_layout.note: each record is 15360 bytes of 160x96 luma followed by 3840 bytes of chroma. The file is NOT NV12: the writer ('/mnt/c/proart_capture/nv12small.py') appends the INTERLEAVED uv plane, so the stride is 19200 and not 23040, and there is no V plane of its own.

correction.what: the stride. Every reader in this repository assumed a 23040-byte NV12 frame; the files are 19200-byte records. Read at 23040, every frame is torn between two real frames. This lane was written against the CORRECTED stride from the start and has never published a number computed on the torn reading; the torn reading is run only as a labelled sensitivity row.
correction.affects: the seeded corpus maps, and therefore TEACHER-LOO-FOLDS.md §2 and §3, which were computed on torn frames. Those two sections are measured on an instrument that was reading a tear, not the person.

correlation_params.detrend: 2 s moving average, from audio_video_alignment.detrend; both signals are detrended before every comparison
correlation_params.statistic: max over lags of the Pearson correlation on the 32 ms hop grid
correlation_params.lag_sign: a POSITIVE lag means the mouth signal leads the speech envelope, the same convention as audio_video_alignment.correlate

audio_gate.note: the repo's own gate, so 'speech' means the same thing here as it does everywhere else

stride_evidence.reading: the correct stride makes consecutive frames nearly identical (correlation near 1, mean consecutive difference near zero). The 23040-byte stride that the repository uses tears every frame between two real frames, so its consecutive difference is two orders of magnitude larger and its correlation is near zero.

wrong_session_C_audio_A_video.note: C's speech envelope is flat at 0.003, so this correlation is numerically unstable. Reported, not used to judge anything.

wrong_session_C_audio_B_video.note: C's speech envelope is flat at 0.003, so this correlation is numerically unstable. Reported, not used to judge anything.

wrong_session_A_audio_B_video.note: A and B recite the SAME poem, so their speech envelopes agree with each other. This row measures content match, not session identity, and it is NOT used to judge the mouth.

wrong_session_B_audio_A_video.note: A and B recite the SAME poem, so their speech envelopes agree with each other. This row measures content match, not session identity, and it is NOT used to judge the mouth.

mouth_signal.note: the landmark model detected NO face in any of the 4500 empty-room frames, so there is no mouth signal to correlate. The control is VACUOUS by construction, and that is itself the result: the model does not hallucinate a mouth in an empty room, so the empty room's motion cannot be a mouth.

empty_room.energy_ratio_note: the empty room's mean motion-map energy as a fraction of session A's, both from the SAME pipeline (row-band removal then 2x2 downsample). TEACHER-LOO-FOLDS.md §2 quotes 0.0000066 for this ratio, measured on the TORN frames.

A.note: TEACHER-LOO-FOLDS.md §3's offsets, computed on the TORN frames; the mouth correlation is evaluated at the same offset in seconds on the correct frames

B.note: TEACHER-LOO-FOLDS.md §3's offsets, computed on the TORN frames; the mouth correlation is evaluated at the same offset in seconds on the correct frames

torn_frames.note: the SAME pipeline on the 23040-byte stride the repository uses. Recorded so the difference between the two readings is visible rather than asserted.

headline.statistic: max over +/-15 s of the Pearson correlation of the detrended signals on the 32 ms hop grid
headline.offset_policy: SEARCHED, not assumed to be zero. The audio and the video of A/B/C are separate recordings that were started independently, so their relative offset is unknown. The video is 30.00 s and the audio 29.98 s -- the same LENGTH, but equal length does not mean equal START, and the capture script's own docstring says the two were started independently. The +/-15 s search covers every relative start possible, because the video is 30 s long and the audio 30 s long.
headline.wrong_session_same_content_note: A's audio against B's video and B's audio against A's video. A and B are two takes of the same person reciting the SAME poem, so their speech envelopes agree with each other at a correlation far above this lane's null -- which is the CEILING for any signal that tracks speech content. These rows are reported and NOT used to judge the mouth.
headline.wrong_session_c_audio_note: C's speech envelope is a flat line at 0.003, so a correlation against it is the ratio of two near-constant signals and is numerically unstable. Reported, not used to judge anything.
headline.mouth_width_note: the horizontal distance between the mouth corners. A mouth that OPENS does not get wider, so this is a control on the same lips: if the mouth width correlates MORE than the mouth aperture, the correlation cannot be about the mouth opening.
headline.head_motion_note: the vertical position of the face in the frame, which is the signal the eye-distance control is really measuring. It is recorded because it says what the correlation is ABOUT.
headline.reading: The mouth-aperture correlation at its best offset, MINUS the same max-over-lags statistic on the permuted speech. The verdict requires ALL FIVE checks: beating the scrambled-audio null; beating the eye-distance control (a landmark that must not track speech); beating the mouth-width control (a mouth that OPENS does not get WIDER); beating the clean wrong-session control; and replicating on the two halves of the recording. A correlation that beats the null but not the other controls is a correlation about the whole frame moving, not about a mouth.
